_meta.indication: Treatment of geographic atrophy (GA) secondary to age-related macular degeneration (AMD)

pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-masked, sham-controlled, multicenter, 2-part study of Zimura 1, 2, and 4 mg vs sham; treated monthly for 18 months.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with geographic atrophy (GA) secondary to age-related macular degeneration (AMD)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Mean rate of change from baseline in total area of GA lesion(s) in the study eye at Month 12
pivotal_trials.n: 286 randomized (Part 1 N=77; Part 2 N=209); Month 12 primary analysis IZERVAY 2 mg N=67 vs Sham N=110
pivotal_trials.result: At Month 12, GA rate of growth 1.22 vs 1.89 mm2/year (difference 0.67 [95% CI 0.21-1.13]; 35% reduction; p<0.01); reduction in the mean rate of GA growth over 12 months was 27.38% (p=0.0072) for combined Zimura 2 mg vs sham.

pivotal_trials.design: Phase 3 randomized, double-masked, sham-controlled, multicenter 24-month study of IZERVAY 2 mg vs sham monthly for the first 12 months, with re-randomization at Month 12 to monthly or every-other-month.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with geographic atrophy (GA) secondary to age-related macular degeneration (AMD)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Mean rate of growth (slope) of GA area measured by FAF at baseline, Month 6, and Month 12 (square root transformation)
pivotal_trials.n: 448 subjects randomized (447 treated); IZERVAY 2 mg N=225 vs Sham N=222
pivotal_trials.result: At Month 12, GA rate of growth 1.75 vs 2.12 mm2/year (difference 0.38 [95% CI 0.12-0.63]; 18% reduction; p<0.01); the reduction in mean rate of GA growth over 12 months was 14.25% (p=0.0064).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions were conjunctival hemorrhage (13% vs 9% sham), increased IOP (9% vs 1%), blurred vision (8% vs 5%), and neovascular AMD/choroidal neovascularization (7% vs 4%).
target_moa: Avacincaptad pegol is a PEGylated RNA aptamer (complement inhibitor) that binds to and inhibits complement protein C5, preventing formation of the terminal fragments C5a and C5b-9 (membrane attack complex).

rems.type: There are no recommended post marketing risk evaluation and management strategies (i.e., REMS) for this drug product.

advisory_committee.vote: The application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the clinical trial design is similar to a previously approved product in the class.

The adequate and well controlled studies (OPH2003 and ISEE2008) contained in this application establish the efficacy of IZERVAY (avacincaptad pegol intravitreal solution), 20 mg/mL for the treatment of geographic atrophy (GA) secondary to age-related macular degeneration (AMD) when the product is administered intravitreally monthly (approximately every 28 \pm 7 days) for up to 12 months.
